boundary.query: Take this English landing page and make a Vietnamese version that reads like it was written for Vietnamese users.
boundary.note: English source + target language = translate (transcreation lane), even when the ask stresses nativeness.

quality_cases.prompt: Localize these English UI strings into natural Vietnamese for members of the Amavo dating app. Preserve JSON structure, keys, placeholders ({name}, %1$d) and HTML tags (<b>). 'Rose' is the paid gift currency; 'match' is a mutual like.

assertions.check: check_localization_integrity.py source target -> OK (keys, order, tokens {name}/%1$d/<b> preserved)
each protected token appears the same number of times as source (no extra {name})
'Rose'/'match' handled by established VN usage, not blanket-preserved or blanket-literal; choice noted if house term undecided
buttons are verbs, error message is action-first and non-blaming
no adverbial calque / no 'được thiết kế nhằm' in the Vietnamese

notes: Trigger routing across the 4-skill family lives in _shared/trigger-evals.json. method:integrity uses scripts/check_localization_integrity.py (blocking on syntax/token failure); method:lint uses the target language's lint_style_patterns.py; method:review needs a native reviewer. Native realization per target lives in references/native-<lang>.md.
